issues.description: The UML diagram and the textual instructions indicate that the Farm.animals attribute is private (aggregation shown with '-' and the text asks for a getter and setter), but the solution implementation declares the field as public (public List<Animal> animals;). The template Farm.java also leaves the field to be implemented by students. This visibility mismatch between the specification (private field with accessors) and the solution (public field) can confuse students about the intended encapsulation and whether they must provide getter/setter methods.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent with the UML and instructions: declare the animals field private in the solution (private List<Animal> animals;) and keep public getter and setter methods. Update the solution repository Farm.java to use a private field and provide the getAnimals()/setAnimals() methods, or adjust the problem statement/UML to explicitly permit a public field if that was intentional.
